messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT triggered for dedicated pool resv-eu-2 — GPU utilization 99-100% for last 8m; queue depth increasing. Severity: P1.

sre_jordan: Ack. seeing backlog on queue-shard-7. Enterprise tenants affected (AcmeCorp, VerdantHealth). Throttles start at ~10:03 UTC, error spike ~10:08.

eng_sam: Confirming metrics — rolling 1m avg GPU util 99.2%, scale attempts hitting max_nodes. Autoscaler log shows `Reached max capacity`.

eng_lina: Which max is that? I thought resv-eu-2 had max_nodes=24 for committed pool.

eng_sam: Correct. `max_nodes=24` hit at 10:05. queue depth:
- 10:00 -> 218
- 10:05 -> 510
- 10:12 -> 820

ops_mike: AcmeCorp appears to be running heavy fine-tuning jobs and not respecting reservation limits — noisy neighbor pattern. Their reservation usage jumped from 35% -> 88% in 3m.

cs_emma: CS on call — I've opened a ticket to Acme and DM'd their ENG contact. They're seeing 429 rate-limits in-app.

sre_jordan: Immediate mitigations we can do now:
1) Temporarily prioritize enterprise reservations: evict best-effort jobs. Command:
```
kubectl label pods --selector=pool=resv-eu-2,priority=best-effort evict=true
```
2) Route read-only traffic to fallback hosted model variants (redwood-hosted-eu) for non-sensitive tenants.
3) Request increase of burst capacity (manual approval) to add +4 GPUs from burst pool.

eng_lina: Trying eviction script now. Running:
```
./scripts/evict_best_effort.sh --pool resv-eu-2 --dry-run
```
Dry run shows ~120 pods eligible.

sre_jordan: Go ahead with non-dry run, but exclude reserved-tenant pods.

eng_lina: Executed. Evicted ~95 pods. Queue depth dropped to ~430 after 45s.

devops-zenbot: AUTOSCALER event: scale_up_request(4) queued at 10:15; provider quota check failed — account quota 28 GPUs, requested would exceed permission.

eng_sam: So autoscaler couldn't add nodes because provider quota/limit. Ops: can we request temporary quota increase? How fast?

ops_mike: Filing support request with cloud provider now (ref INC-9492). ETA appears 45-60m for approval if we escalate.

cs_emma: Notified ACME that we're mitigating; they're asking for ETA on full recovery.

sre_jordan: Short-term customer-facing plan: 1) continue eviction of best-effort, 2) route eligible traffic to hosted fallback for non-PII requests, 3) enable per-tenant throttling on low-priority routes. Implementing 1 & 2 now.

eng_sam: Implemented routing rule: `route.policy=fallback-hosted` for non-reserved clients. Traffic for Acme stays on dedicated.

sre_jordan: Impact summary so far: Acme saw increased 429/503s between 10:03-10:22. Other enterprise tenants saw increased latency 2-3x. No data loss. Customer success notified.

cs_emma: Logged customer tickets and set expectation: 60-90m for cloud quota resolution; we offered temporary hosted routing for non-sensitive calls.

eng_lina: Provider support responded: we can expedite but need business justification. Ops provided docs, escalated.

sre_jordan: Post-mitigation status update at 10:40: queue depth 210, GPU util 76%, cluster stable. Continuing monitoring.

devops-zenbot: AUTOSCALER: quota_increase(28->32) approved at 11:02. New nodes provisioning.

eng_sam: Added 4 nodes manually; pool hit 28 -> 32 GPUs. After nodes ready, queue drained to 42 by 11:12.

sre_jordan: Action items:
- Create incident ticket INC-2026-196754 (owner: sre_jordan)
- Postmortem to include: autoscaler max_nodes default, provider quota visibility, noisy-tenant detection & rate-limits, pre-approved burst policy.
- CS follow-up with Acme for billing/behaviour.

cs_emma: I'll coordinate the customer comms and follow-up.

ops_mike: Recommend adding cloud quota into our runbooks and alerting when requested>available capacity.

sre_jordan: Handoff to night oncall @eng_sam for continued monitoring. If latency >2x or queue depth >300 reopen page.

eng_sam: Ack, taking over. Will keep an eye and escalate if anything bounces back. Thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: Incident status changed -> MONITORING. P1 -> mitigated. Channel will remain open for follow-up notes.

sre_jordan: Added short incident log and saved logs to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1967543210/logs/.

cs_emma: Closing loop with Acme: they accepted temporary fallback and will reschedule heavy jobs. Will update ticket later today. :thumbsup:

eng_lina: Will open a PR for better noisy-tenant detection and automatic soft-throttle heuristics.

sre_jordan: Thanks all — postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow. Handoff complete.
